# How Can I Set Up a System That Works for Both English and Portuguese Speaking Teams?


You set up a bilingual system by using a platform with native multi-language support, so English and Portuguese speaking teams work in the same structure without a translation barrier. On **Jestor** , this runs through native support for **Portuguese and English** .


A platform available in only one language forces the other team to work around a barrier, either through informal translation or reduced comfort using the tool day to day.


## What a single-language platform costs


- One team working around a language barrier the tool itself creates
- Reduced comfort and adoption for whichever team doesn't get their native language
- Informal translation work that adds friction to routine daily use
- Difficulty maintaining consistent terminology across the language divide


## How multi-language platform support works


- The interface is available natively in both **Portuguese and English**
- Each team member can work in their own preferred language
- Both teams share the same underlying structure and data, just displayed differently
- No informal translation is needed for either team's daily use


## Why Jestor fits this use case


- Native multi-language support removes the barrier a single-language tool creates
- Both teams get equal comfort using the platform in their own language
- Shared underlying data means language choice doesn't fragment the actual structure
- This scales from a two-language team to a company operating across many countries


Single-language platform Native multi-language support


Barrier for one team Comfortable for both, natively


## Frequently Asked Questions


**Does each user choose their own language independently?** Yes, language is typically a personal display preference per user. More at[jestor.com](https://www.jestor.com/?ref=blog.jestor.com) .


**Does this affect the underlying data structure between languages?** No, both language displays reference the same shared underlying data.


**Are additional languages supported beyond English and Portuguese?** Yes, the platform supports additional languages as well.
